name: Mealie
description: Recipe manager and meal planner: import recipes from websites, plan meals and build shopping lists. Single container with SQLite (enough for a household).

volumes.name: data
volumes.description: Recipes, images and the SQLite database.

security: Mealie starts with a default administrator (changeme@example.com / MyPassword): sign in and change it immediately, before publishing.
Sign-up is off; invite household members from the admin page.

notes: Its API (bearer tokens, used by apps and shortcuts) needs direct access. Mealie supports OpenID Connect with authentik.

limitations: SQLite suits a household; for many concurrent users switch to PostgreSQL (not offered by this recipe).
manualSetup: Sign in as changeme@example.com with MyPassword, complete the setup wizard and change the password.

update.notes: Mealie migrates its database on start; updates back up the data volume first.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: health, own API, network isolation, modular stack, stop/start, Traefik file route, backup and restore, removal with data.
